The '''Kabus-Dabeh Monstrosity''' was a creature that resided in the ruins of [[Kabus-Dabeh]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muzara]]. It had four tentacles that were tipped with [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] barbs, a fang-filled maw and a lumpy tail.
